questions: What does the fifth engine-private SetupBones callback argument point at? Its optionality is settled - CModelRender::DrawModel passes the address of a stack local and CModelRender::DrawModelShadow passes NULL for the same slot - but what the callee writes there is not.
Which CModelRender state fields choose the StudioRender ordinary, flexed, and material-specific mesh branches?
Do the allocator variants 0x201139c0, 0x201134e0 and 0x201136e0 ever evict a studio model's cache_user, or only hunk allocations that no model owns?
What do the render info's two 16-bit fields at +0x08 and +0x0a select, and what are the dwords at +0x0c, +0x10, +0x14 and +0x1c?

findings.fact: CModelRender::RenderModel builds the studio draw's render info as eight dwords at +0x00 through +0x1c, and CStudioRender::DrawModel reads no further.
findings.evidence: 0x200a6191-0x200a61d5 fills the stack local passed as the first argument at 0x200a6210-0x200a6221: +0x00 the studio header, +0x04 the renderable plus 0xc0, two 16-bit fields at +0x08 and +0x0a defaulted to 0xffff and otherwise loaded from a 24-byte-stride per-instance table, dwords at +0x0c, +0x10, +0x14 and +0x1c, and the entity at +0x18. StudioRender 0x2c004fc7 reads +0x00, 0x2c005150 and 0x2c005110 zero-extend the two 16-bit fields, and 0x2c00511d-0x2c005119 pass +0x0c, +0x10 and +0x14 on.
findings.consequence: The whole struct is a bounded 32-byte copy off a pointer the draw hook already holds, so the capture retains it verbatim; only +0x00 and +0x18 are decoded, and what the remaining fields mean stays an open question rather than a field name.

findings.fact: A studio model's bytes are a Quake cache_user_t at model_t+0xb0, so the studiohdr is *(model+0xb0) and the model owns no other copy of it.
findings.evidence: CModelLoader::GetExtraData 0x200bb6f0 branches on the type at model+0x88 — 2 returns model+0xb8 directly, 3 takes model+0xb0, calls Cache_Check 0x20114780 with it, and on a zero result calls CModelLoader::LoadModel 0x200b8960 before returning *(model+0xb0) and reporting "CModelLoader::GetExtraData: re-caching %s failed" if it is still zero.
findings.consequence: A studiohdr address stops being valid exactly when that one word is nulled, and an evicted model returns from a later GetExtraData at a different address, which is what a census sweep sees as a header that no longer reads as its own.

findings.fact: CModelLoader::UnloadModel is 0x200b8e60 and only clears reference bits; it frees nothing.
findings.evidence: CEngineClient::UnloadModel 0x2001a7b0 loads the model-loader singleton from 0x201a6774 (0x21007598), whose only writer 0x200b63f0 installs vtable 0x20174f74, whose slot +0x18 is 0x200b8e60; slot +0xc is 0x200bb6f0, the GetExtraData its own string names. 0x200b8e60 is two instructions: *(uint *)(model+0x84) &= ~flags.
findings.consequence: The interface slot reached from CEngineClient::UnloadModel is an unreference, so a hook on it would record a reference drop and never a freed studiohdr.

findings.fact: The cache free is a store inlined at several allocator sites rather than one callable boundary, and the standalone Cache_Free is bypassed by the two paths a map change takes.
findings.evidence: Cache_Free 0x201146f0 takes one cache_user_t, asserts "Cache_Free: not allocated", unlinks and nulls *cache_user. The same body is inlined in Cache_Alloc 0x201147f0, whose eviction loop takes the LRU victim at DAT_21306748[1] and nulls it whenever Cache_TryAlloc 0x20114200 fails; in Cache_Flush 0x201143a0, which walks the whole LRU list from DAT_21306744 doing the same; and in the allocator variants 0x201139c0, 0x201134e0 and 0x201136e0. Every copy is identified by the assert it guards the store with.
findings.consequence: No single hookable function is the model-cache free. Catching one needs Cache_Alloc and Cache_Flush bracketed alongside Cache_Free and a sweep of the recorded headers after each, and even then the event is 'these headers no longer read' rather than a per-model free, because the store has no call boundary of its own.

findings.fact: client.dll submits animated entities through VEngineModel006 method slot +0x8.
findings.consequence: The SetupBones callback and final skinning seam cross from client.dll into engine.dll.

findings.fact: The engine VEngineModel006 factory returns the static object at 0x20d63830.
findings.consequence: The runtime-installed vtable can be recovered from the object's constructor.

findings.fact: The VEngineModel006 object receives vtable 0x20174c54 and its +0x8 DrawModel slot is 0x200a6640.
findings.evidence: constructor write at 0x200a5b76 and raw vtable dword at 0x20174c5c.
findings.consequence: 0x200a6640 is the engine-side continuation of C_BaseAnimating::InternalDrawModel.

findings.fact: CModelRender::DrawModel is __thiscall with nine callee-cleaned dword stack arguments, returns int in EAX, and its relocatable prologue is nine bytes with no relative operand.
findings.evidence: Both exits at 0x200a676b and 0x200a6971 are RET 0x24 preceded by XOR EAX,EAX and MOV EAX,0x1; 0x200a6640 is 83ec248b1528331720 (SUB ESP,0x24; MOV EDX,[0x20173328]), and nothing branches into 0x200a6640-0x200a6648.
findings.consequence: The engine draw frame can be bracketed by an inline detour, which is what encloses a pose build and the StudioRender draw it feeds for every client class rather than only for C_BaseAnimating.

findings.fact: Most studio draws do not pass through C_BaseAnimating::InternalDrawModel, including draws of fully animated cast models.
findings.evidence: One complete sp_theatre capture records 399,198 CStudioRender::DrawModel calls against 90,747 C_BaseAnimating::InternalDrawModel calls; the unenclosed draws include character/npc/unique/Downtown/Lacroix/Lacroix.mdl, Sheriff.mdl and character/pc/male/brujah/armor0/brujah_Male_Armor_0.mdl.
findings.consequence: The client draw entry is not the common parent of the pose build and the draw; CModelRender::DrawModel is, so draw attribution is scoped from engine.dll rather than client.dll.

findings.fact: CModelRender::DrawModel invokes IClientRenderable::SetupBones through renderable vtable slot +0x3c with five staged arguments.
findings.evidence: engine.dll 0x200a68a7-0x200a68ca; client public vtables place DrawModel and SetupBones 0x18 bytes apart, matching slots +0x24 and +0x3c.
findings.consequence: The client bone-to-world matrices are produced directly into an engine-provided output buffer on the render submission path.

findings.fact: VEngineModel006 slot +0x34 is a tail thunk to TStudioRender012 slot +0x40.
findings.consequence: StudioRender allocates or exposes the bone output buffer; the same four staged arguments remain on the stack before the client SetupBones call.

findings.fact: CModelRender::RenderModel submits prepared model state through TStudioRender012 slot +0x58.
findings.consequence: The remaining poseToBone and vertex-skinning trace belongs in StudioRender.dll.

findings.fact: Exactly two sites in engine.dll call TStudioRender012 slot +0x58, and no other loaded module holds the interface.
findings.evidence: Only engine.dll and StudioRender.dll contain the string TStudioRender012; the interface pointer lives in engine global 0x20d63ef0, written only by its acquisition at 0x200a5a40 and cleared at 0x200a5aa1; tracking every one of the 72 reads of that global to the vtable register it feeds yields slot +0x58 at 0x200a6221 and 0x200a6ce4 only.
findings.consequence: The set of routes to CStudioRender::DrawModel is closed, so a draw that no bracket encloses is a missing hook rather than an unknown path.

findings.fact: CModelRender::DrawModelShadow is the second route to CStudioRender::DrawModel, and it is not reachable from CModelRender::DrawModel.
findings.evidence: 0x200a6990 opens the VProf marker CModelRender::DrawModelShadow at 0x201a6280 and calls slot +0x58 at 0x200a6ce4; it is VEngineModel006 vtable slot +0x44 (0x20174c98); the only other +0x58 site, 0x200a6221, sits in CModelRender::RenderModel 0x200a5f00, whose single direct caller is 0x200a6945 inside CModelRender::DrawModel.
findings.consequence: Two sibling engine frames submit studio draws, so one draw bracket cannot enclose them all.

findings.fact: CModelRender::DrawModelShadow is __thiscall with four callee-cleaned dword stack arguments, returns nothing, and its relocatable prologue is six bytes with no relative operand.
findings.evidence: Both exits at 0x200a6e1f and 0x200a6e52 are RET 0x10 with EAX untouched; 0x200a6990 is 8b1528331720 (MOV EDX,[0x20173328]); nothing branches into 0x200a6990-0x200a6996 and no data word points inside it; the client call site at 0x100d7bc5 stages four arguments.
findings.consequence: The shadow draw frame can be bracketed by an inline detour on the same terms as the ordinary one.

findings.fact: The shadow frame builds its own pose: CModelRender::DrawModelShadow calls IClientRenderable::SetupBones through the same renderable slot +0x3c, staging the bone buffer from VEngineModel006 slot +0x34, boneMask 0x15e and an LOD-shifted maxBones, and passing NULL for the fifth argument.
findings.evidence: engine.dll 0x200a6c4e-0x200a6c7b stages PUSH 0 / PUSH float / PUSH edi / PUSH 0x15e / PUSH eax, against 0x200a68a7-0x200a68ca in CModelRender::DrawModel which stages LEA ECX,[ESP+0x20] in the same slot.
findings.consequence: A pose build is not evidence of the ordinary draw frame; the fifth argument is an optional caller-supplied pointer rather than a required one.

findings.fact: The client shadow manager is what enters the shadow frame, through VEngineModel006 slot +0x44.
findings.evidence: client.dll holds the interface at global 0x104a57d8 and calls slot +0x44 only at 0x100d7bc5, inside the routine that immediately before sets the shadow material variables $shadowdir, $toppoint, $bottompoint, $topcolor and $bottomcolor at 0x100d7af9-0x100d7b85.
findings.consequence: The unbracketed draws are shadow submissions of actors that the ordinary frame also draws, not draws of unseen actors.

functions.label: c_modelrender_drawmodel
functions.role: VEngineModel006 slot +0x8; engine-side animated-model draw entry reached from client C_BaseAnimating::InternalDrawModel.

functions.label: init_studiorender
functions.role: Loads StudioRender.dll and acquires TStudioRender012 into engine global 0x20d63ef0.

functions.label: c_modelrender_rendermodel
functions.role: CModelRender::RenderModel; calls TStudioRender012 slot +0x58 at 0x200a6221 and is reached only from CModelRender::DrawModel at 0x200a6945.

functions.label: c_modelrender_drawmodelshadow
functions.role: VEngineModel006 slot +0x44; the second engine draw frame, entered from the client shadow manager, which builds its own pose and calls TStudioRender012 slot +0x58 at 0x200a6ce4.

functions.label: c_modelrender_get_bone_buffer
functions.role: VEngineModel006 slot +0x34 tail-forwards to TStudioRender012 slot +0x40, returning the bone output buffer used as SetupBones argument one.

relationships.evidence: cross-DLL VEngineModel006 +0x44 dispatch from the client shadow manager
